name: numbers-native
description: Work directly with native Apple Numbers documents on macOS. No Excel conversion.
long_description: 38 tools for native Numbers documents, formulas, compatible formatting, 11 template-linked chart profiles, guided edits, typed CSV/TSV append/upsert, complete file-pair backup/restore/move and PDF/PNG previews. Requires Apple Numbers in a logged-in macOS session and Automation permission for the host. No Accessibility driver or extra API key. Verified on one Mac with Numbers 14.5; other versions are not certified. This MCP bundle provides tools; install the Codex plugin for the accompanying skills.
